title: Brutal Drinks Brutal Bull 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Brutal Drinks’ Brutal Bull Nic Salt e-liquid delivers the bold and unmistakable taste of your favourite sports drink, blending sweet fruit and fizzy notes for a light and refreshing vaping experience. This unique flavour is perfect for fans of drink-inspired blends looking for a flavour that stands apart. Crafted by the flavour experts at Just Juice, Brutal Drinks Nic Salts combine intense drink-inspired flavours with a smooth nicotine salt formula. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Brutal Bull is perfect for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod kits, offering satisfying nicotine relief with a smooth throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid is designed to deliver bold flavour in a versatile format. Brutal Bull is part of the Brutal Drinks collection, featuring exciting drink-inspired blends like Pina Colada, Mango Lassi, and Frozen Mojito. Discover the full range for more bold and refreshing flavours.
